slice: channel read-only projection dashboard panel and truthful conversation system summary
purpose: Expose the committed channel projection in the dashboard as a strictly read-only bilingual panel with explicit empty/missing/incompatible/degraded states and no bodies, and correct the conversation system summary to the actual H6a/H6b/offline wiring.

baseline.head: d160756
baseline.note: H0..H6b/H4d/H2c/round-2 host/H7 committed; 1382 baseline tests, UI 209 baseline

implementation.panel: new bilingual Channels tab renders runtime.snapshot().channels (status/source/schema/capturedAt/errorCode; four watermarks; pending appliedThrough/unapplied/unbound/truncated; bindings with channelRef/conversationId/scope/version/appliedWatermark/audienceVersion/replySessionEpoch; connections provider/deployment/accountId/revision; conversations mode/audienceVersion/status/participantCount/nativeConversationId; degraded reasons) with explicit empty/missing/incompatible/field-missing states, no bodies or participant text, no controls, and a clear statement that this is a read-only projection and not real-platform or business acceptance.
implementation.summary: conversation system summary now states the actual state: local conversation/background and bounded Lab channels wired, H6a/H6b channel identity/dedup/audience/tombstone and channel-to-conversation binding/invalidation/projection wired offline, real platform adapters, channel sending and fixed-host acceptance not complete; status stays partial.
